about: Look presets for the series config's style.look (the series form's Look): each a director of photography's brief, one sentence of what the lens, focus, light and stock (or the drawing) do (docs/AUTHORING.md, Writing the look line). Picking one fills the line, which stays the series' own to edit. The sample pictures are img/look/<id>.jpg, each look on the same woman in a red coat, in its own `scene` (a western's frontier street) or else the shared one (LOOK_SCENE), made by tools/make_preset_samples.py. `parts` is the preset in the look builder's rows (look_builder.json), so picking it sets them too.

presets.label: Prestige drama
presets.text: a naturalistic live-action prestige drama shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses: shallow depth of field with the background falling into soft bokeh, low-key practical light in pools, deep soft shadows with lifted blacks, muted desaturated color and fine film grain

presets.label: Neon noir
presets.text: a live-action neo-noir thriller shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses: shallow depth of field, saturated magenta and cyan light at night, glossy reflections, deep black shadows, saturated color and fine film grain
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands alone on a rain-soaked downtown street at night under neon signs, steam rising from a grate

presets.label: 1970s film
presets.text: a live-action 1970s feature shot on 35mm film with zoom lenses: available natural light, warm faded color with soft contrast, visible film grain and a slight halation around the highlights
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands outside a 1970s diner beside a parked station wagon, a gas station sign across the road

presets.label: Documentary
presets.text: a live-action documentary shot handheld on a digital cinema camera with a wide-angle lens: deep focus, real available light, natural true-to-life color and a slight handheld drift
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat walks through a crowded open-air market, stallholders and shoppers around her

presets.label: Black and white
presets.text: a black-and-white live-action film noir shot on 35mm: hard low-key light from single sources, deep black shadows and bright edges, high contrast and fine silver grain
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat waits under a lone streetlamp outside a 1940s hotel at night, a parked sedan at the curb

presets.label: Cool science fiction
presets.text: a live-action science-fiction film shot on large-format digital with spherical lenses: clean precise focus, cool blue-teal practical light, crisp highlights and controlled, sterile color
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in a vast clean corridor of a space station, a curved window onto a ringed planet behind her

presets.label: Sunlit pastoral
presets.text: a live-action period drama shot on 35mm with soft vintage lenses: soft natural light and golden late-afternoon sun, warm painterly color, gentle contrast and soft film grain
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat walks a gravel path past a Georgian country house on a misty morning, a horse-drawn carriage beyond

presets.label: Western
presets.text: a live-action western shot on 35mm anamorphic lenses: wide framing, hard high sun with short black shadows, a dusty haze in the light, a sun-bleached warm grade with dry ochre and faded blue, fine film grain
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in the dusty main street of a frontier town, wooden storefronts and a water tower behind her

presets.label: Thriller
presets.text: a live-action thriller shot on long lenses: compressed depth, cool desaturated color, hard top light and deep shadow, a restless slightly handheld frame, steely blue-grey grade
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in an empty multi-storey car park at night, a single car's headlights behind her

presets.label: Road movie
presets.text: a live-action road movie shot on 35mm wide-angle lenses: warm low golden-hour sun with long shadows and lens flares, a faded warm film stock with soft contrast
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands beside an old car on the shoulder of an empty desert highway, the road running to the horizon

presets.label: Horror
presets.text: a live-action horror film shot on spherical lenses: low-key light from a single weak practical, deep crushed shadows that swallow the edges of the frame, a sickly green-cyan grade, heavy grain
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands at the end of a long dim hallway in an abandoned house, peeling wallpaper, one bare bulb

presets.label: Fantasy
presets.text: a live-action fantasy epic shot on large-format digital: soft haze and shafts of light through the air, rich saturated color, glowing highlights and a gentle bloom, a painterly warm-and-teal grade
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in an ancient moss-covered forest, a ruined stone archway behind her, light shafts through the canopy

presets.label: Romance
presets.text: a live-action romance shot on 35mm with shallow depth of field: warm soft key light, creamy warm tones, a gentle bloom on the highlights, soft background bokeh and a warm portrait stock
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands on a bridge over a river in a European city at dusk, string lights along the railing

presets.label: War

presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in a bombed-out street of rubble and broken walls, smoke drifting across

presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands on a bright painted studio street set of colorful shopfronts and a striped awning, a lamppost beside her

presets.label: 80s VHS
presets.text: 1980s home video shot on a consumer camcorder: soft interlaced picture, smeared bleeding color, crushed highlights, low resolution and tape noise, a slight handheld wobble
presets.scene: A woman in her thirties with short dark hair and a red wool coat stands in a suburban backyard at a birthday party, a picnic table with a cake and balloons behind her

presets.label: 3D animated feature
presets.text: a 3D animated feature film: soft rounded forms and appealing stylized shapes, smooth surfaces with subsurface scattering, warm global illumination with soft bounce light, gentle depth of field and rich saturated color

presets.label: 2D cartoon
presets.text: a 2D hand-drawn cartoon animation with flat 2D illustration, clean black line art, flat solid colors, and cel-shaded artwork

presets.label: Anime
presets.text: a Japanese anime film in hand-drawn 2D: clean expressive line art, cel shading over richly painted backgrounds, luminous color and soft atmospheric light

presets.label: Stop-motion

presets.label: Watercolor storybook
presets.text: a watercolor storybook illustration come to life: soft wet-edged washes of color on textured paper, loose ink outlines, gentle diffuse light and a limited warm palette

presets.label: Graphic novel
presets.text: a graphic novel come to life: bold black ink lines and heavy spot blacks, flat limited color with halftone shading, hard dramatic light and bold shapes against it
